description: This file contains validation logic for document nodes, component blocks, and relationships in a Slate-based editor, including error handling and normalization functions.

classes.name: PropValidationError
classes.description: Custom error class for property validation errors, includes a path property indicating the location of the error.

methods.name: validateComponentBlockProps
methods.description: Validates component block properties based on schema, handling different kinds such as form, child, relationship, conditional, object, and array.

methods.name: isText
methods.description: Type guard to check if a node is a TextWithMarks.

methods.name: getValidatedNodeWithNormalizedComponentFormProps
methods.description: Recursively validates and normalizes a Slate node, especially component blocks and relationships.

methods.name: validateAndNormalizeDocument
methods.description: Validates the structure of a document and normalizes its nodes using Slate's Editor.
